summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. files Form 6-K disclosing a stock transfer agreement executed on May 20, 2026 to acquire 100% of Tokai Sports Co., Ltd. (a Japanese sports education firm) from two individual sellers for an undisclosed cash consideration. The board approved the transaction on May 15, 2026. All 400 outstanding shares will be acquired, making Tokai Sports a wholly owned subsidiary. Closing is expected June 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions including shareholder approval. No price per share, premium, or break fee is stated. Watch for regulatory clearance and the completion of closing conditions; risk is low as the deal appears friendly and consensual.
